stages.completion_condition: The refinement conforms to the selected handler's result schema and preserves every submitted acceptance criterion verbatim. A clarification question is permitted only when mutually incompatible explicit user-visible interpretations require a needs_decision outcome; completed refinements leave clarification_questions empty. Follow the selected handler's result protocol for the outer envelope.

The task-specific work_product contains only schema_version=1.0.0, result_type=FEATURE_SPECIFICATION, and stories [{title, description, acceptance_criteria, priority}]. Priority is LOW, NORMAL, HIGH, or CRITICAL. Use the smallest set of independently useful product stories. Every accepted criterion appears verbatim in at least one story, and no story adds a new acceptance criterion. Teams carries operator constraints forward; the architect owns technical design decisions. Follow the selected handler's result protocol for the outer envelope.

The task-specific work_product contains only schema_version=1.0.0, result_type=FEATURE_PLAN, architecture, design_decisions, assumptions, and tasks. Each task contains only story_index, title, description, acceptance_criteria, backward depends_on indexes, empty validates, write_scope, purpose=IMPLEMENTATION, complexity, risk, critical_path, attempt_limit, and review_round_limit. story_index is one zero-based integer naming the task's primary story; it is never an array. depends_on and validates are zero-based integer arrays; validates must be empty. If one task supports more than one story, select its primary story_index and state the cross-story requirement in that task's acceptance criteria. write_scope is the small list of repository-relative files or directories expected to change. Tasks may run in parallel only when their write_scope values are disjoint; overlapping or uncertain scopes require a dependency. The plan is repository-grounded, acyclic, uses true dependencies, preserves layer ownership, and contains only work needed for the accepted feature. Follow the selected handler's result protocol for the outer envelope.
